SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF SEP-06-2016 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF SEP-06-2016 BY JUDGE PRO TEM DAVID LAVINE. APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF VANESSA ALEJANDRO & DEFENDANT'S REPRESENTATIVE JIM DEVARD, RETAINED CLAIMS REPRESENTATIVE FOR SAFEWAY. NO PROOF OF SERVICE ON FILE, BUT DEFENDANT WAIVED SERVICE OF PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM AT TODAY'S HEARING. PARTIES SIGNED STIPULATION FOR PRO TEM JUDGE. EXHIBITS NOT RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: DAVID LAVINE. CLERK: K. DOUGHERTY. NOT REPORTED. (D506).
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-06-2016 - JUDGMENT.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF ALEJANDRO, VANESSA IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT SAFEWAY STORE 	64 DEFENDANT WAIVED SERVICE. PLAINTIFF IS UNABLE TO MEET HER BURDEN OF SHOWING THAT DEFENDANT WAS ON ACTUAL OR CONSTRUCTIVE NOTICE OF THE SODA SPILL BEFORE SHE SLIPPED IN IT GIVEN THE STORE'S FREQUENT SWEEPING SCHEDULE, AND THUS CANNOT ESTABLISH LIABILITY BY SAFEWAY. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
